stories.title: Process & organic growth
challenge: Development was handled based on immediate needs, **without standardized processes, planning, or systems**.
responsibilities: Built a structured **development process**.
Improved **SEO performance** in less than 1 month.
Developed the product **roadmap**.
impact: **SEO** was completed **~20 days ahead of schedule**.
**Scrum** became the team's standard working process.
**Premium Subscription roadmap** was structured for the next 4 sprints.

stories.title: Cost efficiency & monetization
challenge: **High operational costs** due to dependency on Railway hosting.
**No payment gateway integration** for direct user transactions.
**No freemium scheme** to support marketing and user acquisition strategies.
responsibilities: **Reduced costs** and improved platform operational efficiency.
Led the **payment gateway implementation** for user transactions.
**Aligned the freemium scheme** with marketing acquisition targets.
initiatives: **Migrated the server** from Railway to an **independent VPS**.
**Reduced server workload** to lower monthly operational costs.
Implemented **payment gateways** via Pakasir and Saweria.
Launched **a freemium model** to accelerate user acquisition.
impact: **~66% expense efficiency** — operational costs cut from $150 to $50/month through controlled resource management.
**Secure payment gateway** integration to support transactions and recurring revenue.
Accelerated new user acquisition and marketing conversion through access to basic features (**Freemium Model**).
